ValidationRule.description: Route and District may only be set when Type is Local Survey. Aligns with EUSFA_TaskSchedulerHelper (sales hierarchy used for Local Survey matching).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type__c, "Local Survey")), OR( NOT(ISBLANK(Route_Geo__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(District_Geo__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Zone__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Region__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Division__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Route and District may only be populated when Type is Local Survey. Clear those fields or set Type to Local Survey.
